name: T1
summary:

Booster positions its robots for researchers, developers and education users working on locomotion, perception and coordinated behavior, with a compact mechanical design intended to tolerate the demands of experimentation.

description.en:
Booster T1 is a humanoid development platform supported by an open software and documentation ecosystem. Booster positions its robots for researchers, developers and education users working on locomotion, perception and coordinated behavior, with a compact mechanical design intended to tolerate the demands of experimentation.

The development resources include a T1 manual, robot SDK, ROS 2 interfaces and example projects. A companion app provides control, status feedback and network setup. Booster also publishes robot-soccer development resources covering perception, localization and decision making. These tools allow teams to build their own applications and evaluate motion policies on physical hardware rather than use only preset demonstrations.
